message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Excellent! Alison has found a time that works for everyone and has booked the meeting.

My task is now to send the confirmation email to the partners. The meeting is on Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. I will now use the `send_confirmation_email` function.

The email body should be professional and include all the necessary details. I will confirm the date, time, and that it is a 30-minute meeting for the four partners.I see Alison has booked the meeting. I will now send the confirmation email to all four partners for the meeting on Thursday, November 19 at 14:30.

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"start":"14:30","day":"Thu","body":"Dear Partners,
